info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account Insights API
Returns the insight details from tracepoints and indicators for tokens passed.

params.name: insightTokens
params.description: Comma-separated list of Insight Tokens. Tokens can be Tracepoint or Indicator tokens.

items.docs: Returns the insight details from tracepoints and indicators for tokens passed.

info.name: Returns the insight details from tracepoints and indicators for parameters passed.

params.name: insightStatus
params.description: Insight Status. “0” for Active and “1” for Inactive

params.name: insightType
params.description: Insight Type. “0” for Tracepoint and “1” for Indicator (refer InternalLink[Test Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-Test,operations-Test-get_v2_tests_enumeration])

items.docs: Returns the insight details from tracepoints and indicators for parameters passed.

info.name: Create a new insight based on the PostData.

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Set to true to return the created object in the response body, otherwise the response body will only return created object ID.

items.docs: To get payload for creating a new insight and to get the created insight details refer InternalLink[Insight Details with Tokens Endpoint,operations-tag-Insights,operations-Insights-get_v2_insights__insightTokens_]. Pass “0” for Insight ID to create a new insight.

info.name: Update an existing insight based on the request body.

params.name: insightType
params.description: Insight Type. “0” for Tracepoint and “1” for Indicator (refer InternalLink[Test Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-Test,operations-Test-get_v2_tests_enumeration])

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Set to true to return the updated object in the response body, otherwise the response body will only return the updated object ID.

items.docs:
**Request:**

Only the property to be updated can be passed in the request body instead of the whole object. The update request body requires a total of three keys to be filled with appropriate value as listed below:
* **value** – The value property provides the new value.

* **path** – The path property indicates the element to update. The entire path with slashes needs to be provided here. Example: /status/id
